name: APIVerveTruthTableGenerator
summary: Truth Table Generator creates complete truth tables for boolean expressions with support for AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, and NOR operators.
description:
Truth Table Generator creates complete truth tables for boolean expressions with support for AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, and NOR operators.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Truth Table Generator from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
